name: rx-recall-check-mobile
description: React Native app (Android first, iOS supported) for Rx Recall Check. Shared logic lives in src/; screens in app/.

scripts.bundle:android: react-native bundle --platform android --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output build/index.android.bundle --assets-dest build/res
scripts.bundle:ios: react-native bundle --platform ios --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output build/main.jsbundle --assets-dest build/ios-assets
